name: Nemacolin Woodlands Resort
positioning: Family-owned mountain resort on more than 2,200 acres in Pennsylvania's Laurel Highlands, with five distinct places to stay
best_for: Golfers who want two Pete Dye-designed courses
Families and groups who want space, from suites to estates
Travelers who want a resort to stay put at, with spa, wildlife and art on site

facts.text: Nemacolin sits on more than 2,200 private acres in Farmington, Pennsylvania, in the Laurel Highlands.
Nemacolin offers five distinct lodging experiences, each with its own character.
Falling Rock is an adults-oriented art-deco retreat with mountain views.
The Chateau offers Parisian-inspired luxury with grand suites, curated art and butler-style attention.
The Grand Lodge has Tudor-style warmth and is the original heart of the resort.
The Grand Lodge, which houses the original hotel, was reimagined in 2023 as an all-suite accommodation.
The Woodlands Spa offers thermal pools and holistic rituals.
Nemacolin has two golf courses designed by Pete Dye.
The two courses are Mystic Rock and Shepherd's Rock.
On site there are shops, art buildings, an animal safari, hiking trails and ski slopes.
Nemacolin is privately owned and operated by the Hardy family, Pennsylvania natives from the lumber industry.
The culinary program is cultivated by chefs, bakers, sommeliers, mixologists and local farming partners.

highlights.text: Falling Rock is a boutique hotel-within-a-hotel inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright's Fallingwater and is the hub for the golf area.
An on-grounds wildlife habitat is home to animals rehomed from other facilities.
The resort has a showroom for a collection of vintage cars and planes, including a Ford Model T.
On The Chateau's fifth-floor club level, every room is serviced by a dedicated butler.
At the Holistic Healing Center, specialists create a custom wellness plan based on each guest's needs.

considerations.text: Nemacolin is a remote spot in the mountains; guests should map Nemacolin Resort, not the town of Nemacolin.
Nemacolin is a gated retreat for overnight guests and members.
Private transport and airport connections can be arranged with 24 hours' notice.
